node.label: Hyperplasia of midface
node.definition: Abnormally anterior positioning of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased convexity of the face, or increased nasolabial angle. The midface includes the maxilla, the cheeks, the zygomas, and the infraorbital and perialar regions of the face

evidence.snippet: Spastic paraplegia 20, autosomal recessive: Hyperplasia of midface [TAS]
Stickler syndrome, type IV: Hyperplasia of midface (frequency 1/3) [PCS]
